description_chirho: Product Requirements Document for planned improvements to the rsword-chirho pure Rust SWORD library port

features_chirho.description_chirho: Implement a complete OSIS (Open Scripture Information Standard) XML parser for importing Bible modules
requirements_chirho: Parse OSIS XML documents into internal verse structure
Support all major OSIS elements: book, chapter, verse, note, reference
Handle Strong's numbers, morphology, and other scholarly markup
Support verse bridges and variant readings
Generate IMP format output for module creation
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Can parse CrossWire OSIS files without errors
Round-trip conversion (OSIS -> module -> OSIS) preserves content

features_chirho.description_chirho: Implement TEI (Text Encoding Initiative) XML parser for importing lexicon/dictionary modules
requirements_chirho: Support entry, form, sense, and definition elements
acceptance_criteria_chirho: All dictionary entries accessible via lookup

features_chirho.description_chirho: Add async HTTP transport using tokio + reqwest for better performance during module downloads
requirements_chirho: Implement async module download with progress reporting
Support concurrent downloads of multiple modules
Integrate with existing feature flag system

features_chirho.description_chirho: Add support for more versification systems used by various Bible translations
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Each versification correctly maps all books and verses
Modules using these versifications load correctly

features_chirho.description_chirho: Use rayon for parallel loading when scanning and initializing multiple modules
requirements_chirho: Parallel config file scanning in SwMgrChirho
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Module loading is faster on multi-core systems
No race conditions or data corruption
dependencies_chirho: rayon crate already available as optional

features_chirho.description_chirho: Improve search functionality with advanced Tantivy features
requirements_chirho: Fuzzy search with configurable edit distance
acceptance_criteria_chirho: All search types return correct results

features_chirho.description_chirho: Add comprehensive documentation for the public API
requirements_chirho: Doc comments for all public types and functions
acceptance_criteria_chirho: All public items have doc comments
Examples in docs compile and run

features_chirho.description_chirho: Interactive CLI tool for creating new SWORD modules
requirements_chirho: Support for different module types (Bible, commentary, dictionary)
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Created modules load in SWORD applications

features_chirho.description_chirho: Map verses between different versification systems
requirements_chirho: Verse mapping tables between versification systems
Handle split verses (one verse in system A = two verses in system B)
Handle merged verses (two verses in system A = one verse in system B)
API for converting verse references between systems
acceptance_criteria_chirho: Can map any KJV verse to Catholic/LXX equivalent

features_chirho.description_chirho: CLI tool to validate SWORD modules for correctness
requirements_chirho: Verify module index files are valid
Check for missing or corrupt data

technical_debt_chirho.description_chirho: VerseKeyChirho has TODO for implementing reverse lookup from verse index to book/chapter/verse
